description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Omni-Changeling.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Omni-Changeling.
Activate Omni-Changeling by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Omni-Changeling
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
